deadline.value: Recommended deadline for Fall graduate assistantship consideration is February 1.
deadline.quote: The recommended deadline for fall semester graduate assistantship consideration is Feb. 1, although departments/programs may have earlier deadlines.

gre_general.value: Submission of GRE scores is not required for admission.
gre_general.quote: While submission of Graduate Record Examination scores is not required for admission, students who have taken the GRE advanced physics test are urged to submit their test scores to the physics department to facilitate advising and placement.

gre_subject.value: Submission of the GRE advanced physics test is not required for admission but urged to facilitate advising and placement.
gre_subject.quote: While submission of Graduate Record Examination scores is not required for admission, students who have taken the GRE advanced physics test are urged to submit their test scores to the physics department to facilitate advising and placement.

supervisor.value: Incoming graduate students are advised by a departmental graduate adviser for the first two years.
supervisor.quote: Incoming graduate students will be advised by a departmental graduate adviser for the first two years.

funding.value: Graduate assistantships include a monthly stipend and tuition coverage, awarded on a competitive basis.
funding.quote: Graduate Assistant Positions: All graduate assistants receive a monthly stipend, and | most cover the cost of tuition.

entry_route.value: The doctoral degree requires 72 graduate credit hours beyond the bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: The doctoral degree will be awarded to students who complete a minimum of 72-graduate semester credit hours beyond the bachelor's degree.
